scope: Adaptive Professor layer composed around the frozen Phase 1 classroom

capabilities.note: A separately resizable browser window opens the Professor workspace.
The Phase 1 classroom is embedded without modifying its frozen files.
Bounded progress data is stored locally; chats, voice and source documents are excluded.
Six bounded questions establish an initial evidence baseline.
Reflection appears only after a completed Sinbad answer, never after a safe stop.
Lesson opening and self-report do not change mastery; answered checks can.
Explicit reflection is followed by a topic-linked question before mastery changes.
Only assessed topics enter the review schedule; due reviews are actionable.
The bounded local learner contract can be exported and strictly restored.
Learners can inspect mastery impact and explicitly reset only local progress.
Desktop and mobile browser tests include console, mojibake and WCAG A/AA checks.
Inherited from Phase 1 and requires a valid Atlas/Supabase session, workspace and deployed Edge Function.

explicitExclusions: Final maritime curriculum and final topic taxonomy
Automated mastery inference from chat text, voice, facial expression or lesson opening
3D rigged embodied instructor and improvisational gesture engine
Replacement for an approved instructor, simulator, official publication or operational decision process
